# Device reports, read back from the reply queue.

=== DA1 answers a VT220 with colour
source: esctest2 da.py test_DA_NoParameter, test_DA_0
input: \e[c\e[0c
replies: \e[?62;22c\e[?62;22c

=== DA1 with a nonzero parameter is ignored
source: xterm ctlseqs DA1 (Ps = 0 only)
input: \e[1c
replies:

=== DA2 answers type, version and cartridge
source: esctest2 da2.py test_DA2_NoParameter, test_DA2_0
input: \e[>c\e[>0c
replies: \e[>1;0;0c\e[>1;0;0c

=== DSR 5 reports no malfunction
source: xterm ctlseqs DSR Ps = 5
input: \e[5n
replies: \e[0n

=== DSR 6 reports the cursor position
source: xterm ctlseqs CPR
input: \e[3;4H\e[6n
replies: \e[3;4R

=== CPR in origin mode is relative to the margins
source: xterm ctlseqs CPR (origin mode); esctest2 cha.py test_CHA_RespectsOriginMode
input: \e[2;4r\e[?6h\e[2;3H\e[6n
replies: \e[2;3R

=== DECXCPR adds the page
source: esctest2 decdsr.py test_DECDSR_DECXCPR
input: \e[4;5H\e[?6n
replies: \e[?4;5;1R

=== Replies queue in order
source: xterm (replies are written as requests arrive)
input: \e[5n\e[6n
replies: \e[0n\e[1;1R

=== An unknown DSR is ignored
source: xterm ctlseqs DSR
input: \e[99n\e[?99n
replies:

=== OSC 0 is a title event and does not answer the program
source: xterm ctlseqs OSC Ps = 0
input: \e]0;title\x07a
replies:
events:
|title 0 title|
screen:
|a.........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
